steps.caption: Active abort controllers immediately cancel previous in-flight validation requests.

steps.caption: Monotonic sequence tokens capture increasing generation counters on every dispatch.

steps.label: Out-Of-Order Guarding
steps.caption: Stale asynchronous responses are discarded silently to prevent race condition bugs.

steps.label: Pristine State Isolation
steps.caption: Pristine form inputs suppress validation error banners during initial interaction.

steps.caption: Input blur events mark fields as touched to trigger timely error banner display.

steps.caption: Subsequent valid keystrokes immediately clear error messages without waiting for blur.

steps.caption: Form submission attempts transition all fields to touched to reveal complete error lists.
